patthana17.11:1.1: abyākataṃ parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.11:2.1: kusalaṃ mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana17.11:3.1: kusalaṃ appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
